name: requirements
description: Requirements. Turns what paying customers asked for into the build list. Captures each ask in their own words with the feature it becomes, merges the same feature across customers, and ranks the list by how much paid money is behind each line, so you build exactly what was paid for and nothing else. Asks from people who haven't paid wait on a separate list. Logs each customer confirming the list, and marks features done. Use when the user says "what should I build", "requirements", "build list", "they asked for", "what did they want", "scope", "spec", "feature requests", or right after a customer pays.

findings.excerpt: python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/reqs.py" add --deal north-pier --ask "Sync with QuickBooks" --feature "QuickBooks sync"
